objectClass.notes: The archived runtime rig and v1 Box3 are compatibility truth. The IMAGEN sheet reallocates visual masses only inside that contract.

reasoning: Eleven front-control pivots and four shoulder pivots must retain exact local transforms and full animation clearance.
Five stars, four bolts, eight shards and six energy points form a model-owned volumetric ultimate effect.
Front, rear, side and three-quarter identity depend on consistent shell, control and rear-service relationships.
The shared performance system requires deterministic seeking, one timeline owner and exact stop reset.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The redesign changes visual geometry and outline styling while preserving an animation-rich runtime contract.

details.description: Broad cream upper shell with inward lower notch and symmetric handle shoulders.
Two long rounded grips descend and flare toward the palm ends.
Continuous front-to-rear perimeter shell seam.
Diagonal curved cream-to-pink boundary across each grip.
Raised rounded cross D-pad with broad arm fillets.
Four round unlabeled face buttons arranged in a diamond.
Left analog stick rises from a cream socket ring with a recessed cap centre.
Right analog stick mirrors the left with its own socket ring and cap recess.
Small rose status/home lens centred above the select button.
Small horizontal rounded select button below the status lens.
Left and right upper bumpers sit proud of the shoulder deck.
Second pink trigger layer is visible behind and below each bumper.
Rounded rectangular rear battery/service cover centred on the back shell.
Four countersunk circular screw heads repeat across the rear lower shell and grip ends.
Pink rounded rear upper-centre inset interrupts the cream shoulder deck.
Cream analog socket rings carry a narrow catch-light bevel around each pink stick.
Pink button crowns and grip panels have slightly glossier highlights than the cream shell.
Thin dark cavity lines separate buttons, grip panels, battery cover and shell halves.
Stable dark-plum outline hierarchy uses main, structure and detail widths with object-space plus/minus 18 percent variation.
Broad planar shell facets step around the shoulder deck and waist without adding a raised panel.
A controlled plum undercut separates each bumper from its trigger through the full press arc.
Each faceted analog cap keeps a clearly recessed thumb dish and readable crown rim.

definitionOfDone: The broad shoulder deck, narrow waist, deep lower notch and flared grips match the v2 sheet while staying within the v1 full-tree bounds.
All existing animation pivots, semantic sockets, colliders, destruction groups and idle transforms remain compatible.
The model uses broad 6-12 sided facets, restrained stepped bevels and a stable 0.0048/0.0041/0.0033 outline hierarchy.
Anticipation, heartbeat, frenzy, ultimate, ready finale, settle and stop retain one animation owner and exact reset.
